# DashCraft

> Visual dashboard creation studio.

## Overview

DashCraft is a visual dashboard creation studio for building polished analytics dashboards without fighting with code or rigid templates. Users can create, customize, save, and present responsive dashboards with editable widgets, templates, and AI-assisted generation.

- Homepage: https://dashcraft-five.vercel.app/
- Templates: https://dashcraft-five.vercel.app/templates
- About: https://dashcraft-five.vercel.app/about
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/AayZen/dashcraft

## Core Capabilities

- Visual dashboard builder with a 3-zone studio layout (widget library, canvas, property inspector)
- Editable dashboard widgets: KPI cards, bar charts, line/spline charts, area charts, donut charts, tables, progress bars, gauges
- AI-assisted dashboard generation using OpenAI API with structured JSON output
- Offline dashboard synthesis fallback when the OpenAI API is unavailable
- Dashboard templates for SaaS, E-Commerce, DevOps, Marketing, Product Analytics, and Finance
- LocalStorage persistence — all dashboards save locally in the browser
- Undo/redo history with keyboard shortcuts
- Responsive dashboard layouts (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- Presentation/preview mode for clean client presentations
- Keyboard-first workflow with a command palette (⌘K)
- Light, dark, and system theme support

## AI Generation

DashCraft includes two generation modes:

1. **AI Generated**: Uses the OpenAI API (via a secure backend proxy) to generate dashboard layouts from natural language prompts. The API key is never exposed to the frontend.
2. **Synthesized Demo**: An offline fallback that generates demo dashboard data locally without calling any external API. This is clearly labeled as "Synthesized Demo" in the interface.

## Technology Stack

- React 19
- TypeScript
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS 4
- React Router
- Node.js (backend API proxy)
- OpenAI API
- LocalStorage
- SVG-based visualization rendering

## Template Categories

- SaaS Revenue & MRR
- E-Commerce Analytics
- DevOps & Infrastructure
- Marketing & Growth
- Product Analytics
- Finance & Accounting
- Customer Support
